# workflows

## Purpose

GitHub Actions CI pipelines: `ci.yml` (comment hygiene, typecheck, lint, test, build, e2e, db, mutation), `security.yml` (gitleaks secret scan, CodeQL, `pnpm audit`), and `tag-release.yml` (auto-tag patch releases on `main`).

## Contents

- `ci.yml` — triggers on push to `main` and on every PR. Jobs: `comment-hygiene` ("comment hygiene (added lines)" — PR-only; diffs each changed `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.js`/`.jsx`/`.mjs`/`.cjs` file against the PR base ref, scans only added (`+`) lines against the first 10 (keyword-only, no date/ticket/issue) patterns in `.claude/comment-hygiene-patterns.txt`, and hard-fails with the offending lines listed unless the PR carries a `skip-comment-check` label); `test` ("check + unit" — `pnpm check` then `pnpm test:coverage`); `e2e` ("e2e (public smoke)" — runs `e2e/auth-guard.spec.ts` and `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` against dummy Supabase env vars, since those specs only need the app to boot, with no live database; uploads the Playwright report on failure); `e2e-order` ("e2e (order lifecycle)" — installs the Supabase CLI, runs `supabase start` to apply every migration, seeds `supabase/seed/ci-auth-bootstrap.sql` + `supabase/seed/coffee-cart.sql` + `supabase/seed/e2e-merqo-stub.sql` (the `merqo.vendor_profile` RPC the vendor dashboard reads) via `psql`, exports the live local Supabase creds into `$GITHUB_ENV` for the app to pick up, then runs `e2e/customer-order.spec.ts`, `e2e/order-code.spec.ts` and `e2e/vendor-fulfillment.spec.ts`, always tearing down with `supabase stop`); `db` ("db (migrations + pgTAP RLS)" — `supabase start` (applies every migration, failing the job if one is malformed) then `supabase test db` runs the pgTAP suite in `supabase/tests/rls.test.sql`); `build` ("build (next build)" — `pnpm build` with dummy Supabase env vars since dynamic routes render at request time); and `mutation` ("mutation (changed lib)" — PR-only, diffs `src/lib/**/*.ts` changes against the PR base ref and runs `stryker run --mutate` scoped to just those changed files, skipping entirely if none changed; advisory-only since Stryker's `break: null` never fails CI).
- `security.yml` — triggers on push to `main`, every PR, and a weekly cron (`0 6 * * 1`, CodeQL only). Default job permission is `contents: read`. Jobs: `gitleaks` ("secret scan" — skipped on the scheduled run; checks out full history (`fetch-depth: 0`) and runs the pinned gitleaks release binary); `audit` ("dependency audit (pnpm)" — skipped on the scheduled run; hard-gates on `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high`, then runs a full `pnpm audit --audit-level=high || true` informationally for devDeps); `codeql` ("CodeQL (javascript-typescript)" — only runs `if: github.event.repository.private == false`, i.e. self-skips on this private repo since code scanning upload requires GitHub Advanced Security on private repos; would self-enable if the repo went public — uses `security-extended` queries, needs `security-events: write`). The gitleaks job installs the pinned release binary and checks its SHA-256, because gitleaks-action needs a paid license on organization-owned repos. It scans the PR commits, or the pushed range on `main`.
- `tag-release.yml` — triggers on push to `main`. Default job permission `contents: read`, widened to `contents: write` in the `tag` job only. Fetches full history + tags, finds the latest `v*` tag via `git tag -l 'v*' --sort=-v:refname`, and patch-bumps it (`vMAJOR.MINOR.$((PATCH+1))`), or starts at `v0.1.0` if no tag exists yet; creates an annotated tag and pushes it as `github-actions[bot]`. A manual minor/major tag (`vX.Y.0`) becomes the new baseline for future auto-bumps.
- `staging-sync.yml`: on push to `main` (or a manual run), fast-forwards the `staging` branch to `main` so the staging deployment (`qkit-staging.merqo.io`) always runs main's code. Fast-forward only: if `staging` has diverged the job fails instead of overwriting it. Only this job gets `contents: write`.

## Connectivity

All three workflows pin every third-party action to a full commit SHA (with a version comment) rather than a floating tag. `ci.yml`'s `e2e-order` and `db` jobs depend on `supabase/seed/coffee-cart.sql`, `supabase/seed/ci-auth-bootstrap.sql` and (`e2e-order` only) `supabase/seed/e2e-merqo-stub.sql` (outside this folder) and on every file in `supabase/migrations/` applying cleanly. `security.yml` mirrors what the `/security-scan` project skill (`.claude/skills/security-scan/`) runs locally before a push. `tag-release.yml` runs independently of the other two — it isn't gated on `ci.yml`/`security.yml` passing, so a tag is pushed on every push to `main` regardless of CI outcome.

## Parent

[.github](../README.md)

The unit suite runs once with coverage. Vitest enforces at least 80% statements, branches, functions and lines over production source; any existing changed-line coverage gate remains in place.
